items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I never got to meet him. I wish I had, I guess.

ctx.x: …an instant addiction. Can you in retrospect elaborate at all for someone… What is it that just grabbed you so, that it was maybe so different from anything you’d heard or…?

That’s fascinating. In a way the jazz [type?], ‘cause I told you I did an interview for this guy who works at NYU, up at Barnes & Noble, and he kind of asked me, “Well, what was so good about then?” And I almost said, “Dummy, listen to the goddamn thing. Are you kidding? Of course it got my attention. It changed my life.” It was just incredible what, what this guy who was not all that much older than I was. He was in his early twenties and I was, what, thirteen, or something like that, I’d say. That he could do…
